csv_scope_of_work: The City of Altus/Altus Municipal Authority is requesting Statements of Qualifications SOQ's from qualified consulting firms to provide Engineering and Design Services for the City of Altus - Altus Air Force Base Installation Readiness IR Implementation Project, funded through the Office of Local Defense Community Cooperation OLDCC.
